proof_summary: At \(n=473165\), the integer \(5292270077783=a(n)+4\) lies strictly between the two proposed consecutive values. A finite check of exponent classes modulo \(48\), together with \(2^{48}\equiv1\) modulo each prime in \(\{3,5,7,17,97,257,673\}\), shows that one of these primes properly divides \(5292270077783\cdot2^j+1\) for every \(j>0\), so the intervening integer is Sierpiński.
